reason: The PR is centered on user-visible INSERT runtime semantics: it changes core executor/table paths (`pkg/executor/load_data.go`, `pkg/executor/select.go`, `pkg/table/column.go`) to alter NULL-to-NOT-NULL handling for single-row inserts in non-strict mode, with matching executor and integration-test coverage.
